title: Trace both sides of ordered prefetch handoffs before declaring a leak
applies_when: A recursive or pipelined listing returns at a range boundary while background workers wait for result consumption, and a leak hypothesis is based on the consumer's early return alone.
lesson: Read worker admission, input ordering and acknowledgement together. A producer may independently reject every key at or above the same end boundary; with sorted entries, preceding admitted results can already be acknowledged before the consumer reaches that boundary. The return alone does not establish an abandoned ready result. Reproduce through a real ordered backend, delaying valid child listings and testing ends before the first directory, between sibling directories and inside a nested subtree, plus a no-end control. Drain output, check exact keys, then inspect the relevant worker stacks rather than total goroutine count. Separately run the race detector: a shared traversal error read under different per-worker mutexes is not synchronized. An atomic stop flag can repair that race while preserving local error reporting; it does not itself join in-flight backend calls.
avoid_when: Do not assume ordering for a backend that does not guarantee it, or infer complete cancellation/error-path safety from successful bounded-range cases. A worker-stack observation covers only the exercised paths and observation interval; retained work, permanent leakage and an unjoined in-flight call are different claims. Sleeping is not a substitute for a deterministic positive control when diagnosing a specific blocked handoff. A race-free result is not a liveness proof. Existing PR ownership must be checked before proposing another repair; an open PR is not merged coverage.

evidence.note: Pinned implementation checks the end boundary in both workers and consumer, acknowledges a consumed result before recursion, and reads the enclosing traversal error from worker goroutines. These are source mechanisms, not proof that every backend or failure path terminates.
This backend sorts its delimiter-list result before returning. Inspect each target backend's contract rather than transferring this ordering assumption automatically.

Existing proposed atomic-stop repair and public before/after race validation distinguish the shared-error race from a general worker-join guarantee. Do not open a competing PR or treat this as an accepted universal cancellation fix.
Go's memory model requires synchronization for concurrent shared accesses; unrelated mutexes and goroutine exit do not establish the needed happens-before relation.
